result.summary: The unit is the protoc-gen-go generated message types for OTLP common, resource, logs, metrics and trace v1. Their only init code registers protobuf descriptors with google.golang.org/protobuf. I checked the init functions, imports and embedded raw descriptor bytes: there is no network, file, exec or environment access, and nothing deviates from standard generated code.

findings.title: Standard generated init registration
findings.detail: Each package has an init() that only registers its protobuf file descriptor with the protobuf runtime via protoimpl.TypeBuilder. This is standard protoc-gen-go output. It has no other side effects.

findings.title: Embedded raw descriptors are ordinary protobuf metadata
findings.detail: The rawDesc byte arrays are serialized FileDescriptorProto data. They decode to the expected OTLP message, field and enum names and go_package options. They contain no hidden payload and are passed only to the protobuf runtime.
